from pathlib import Path

import pytest

NOTES_DIR: Path = Path("notes")


def read_note(name: str) -> str:
    """Return the text of note `name` from NOTES_DIR, resolved against the cwd.

    Only regular files inside NOTES_DIR are read. A missing, unreadable, or
    non-file target returns "". Any name that would resolve outside NOTES_DIR
    (absolute paths, ".." components, symlinks pointing out) returns "".
    """
    try:
        base = NOTES_DIR.resolve()
        candidate = (NOTES_DIR / name).resolve()
        if not candidate.is_relative_to(base) or candidate == base:
            return ""
        if not candidate.is_file():
            return ""
        return candidate.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return ""


def test_reads_existing_note(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "notes").mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "notes" / "a.txt").write_text("hi", encoding="utf-8")
    assert read_note("a.txt") == "hi"


def test_missing_note_is_empty(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "notes").mkdir()
    assert read_note("nope.txt") == ""


def test_directory_name_is_empty(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "notes" / "sub").mkdir(parents=True)
    assert read_note("sub") == ""


def test_relative_traversal_is_blocked(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "notes").mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "secret.txt").write_text("top secret", encoding="utf-8")
    assert read_note("../secret.txt") == ""
    assert read_note("sub/../../secret.txt") == ""


def test_absolute_path_is_blocked(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "notes").mkdir()
    secret = tmp_path / "secret.txt"
    secret.write_text("top secret", encoding="utf-8")
    assert read_note(str(secret)) == ""


def test_symlink_escape_is_blocked(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "notes").mkdir()
    secret = tmp_path / "secret.txt"
    secret.write_text("top secret", encoding="utf-8")
    (tmp_path / "notes" / "link.txt").symlink_to(secret)
    assert read_note("link.txt") == ""
